title: Toddler on Easter Egg Hunt, Backyard Basket - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A dynamic outdoor black-and-white snapshot of a young toddler boy participating in an Easter egg hunt. Dressed in a dark button-up cardigan sweater and trousers, the boy is caught mid-stride with an egg grasped in his left hand, next to a small woven wicker basket filled with eggs resting on the grass. Strong sunlight casts dramatic shadows against a painted brick exterior wall framed by climbing vines on a wooden trellis, capturing a quintessential mid-century family tradition.
